title: Southwest BBQ Pork Chops with Cheesy Sweet Potato & Red Wine Onions
originalTitle: Hello fresh southwest bbq pork chop
ingredients: Bake halved skin on sweet potato
instructions: Bake with barbecue sauce high heat.
Bake halved skin on sweet potato with salt and pepper. Add cheese at end.
Carmelize onions with salt pepper olive oil sugar and add red wine.
